steps.content: With a wail of the Dragon of Genesis, the barrier blocking the snowstorm shatters and white blizzards sweep near again.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ah... He cleared it...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: The difficulty level hasn't been lowered, has it? Perhaps it was mere luck with the dice and a Critical Success was rolled. Sigh, I waited so long for someone to come, I was having so much fun...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Well, it's not like I can change the rules now...
Whiteness gradually drowns Etti. She watches the world get overthrown.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...The Chosen One defeats the Dragon of Genesis... and goes home... with all the adventurers from Otherworld.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: They'll remember the adventures in Aesthia, remember this journey... remember...
Her vision slowly whitens.
Transition, white flash
Etti, you don't like going out to play? Then... I'll take you on an adventure somewhere else...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...Who's that?
She's back to that fireplace that feels both strange and familiar, flames flickering within. In front of a small, sketchy sandbox, two shadows shake slightly. She hears the voices.
Long, long ago... There was a huge ocean on which countless islands floated...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Islands?
Islands... Hmm, remember your favorite biscuit? A round biscuit floating on milk is like the land beneath us. When you break it up into many pieces, those become islands.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I get it! Islands are broken biscuits!
Yes... Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Can islands fly? Can they?
Huh? Umm... Yes, let's make them fly. This was a world created by a soaring dragon, so it didn't float on the sea but among the clouds.
There were dragons and magic on the islands... And Etti's favorite glittering weapons. Right there, on the islands...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: These are all the things you can't find in DisCity!
Yes, you can't find them in DisCity. You want to go there?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Yes! Tell me more!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Wow! What's next?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Oh gosh, I want more! More adventures please, Grandpa!
Let's continue tomorrow... Grandpa is old, so I must go to bed early. We'll go on with our adventures when we wake up, alright?
(Transition)

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Grandpa, Grandpa! I went on an adventure on my own! That river in the west, I snuck into it and got really close. I saw the monsters!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But that place is scary, it's different from the adventures you told me about... I prefer Aesthia...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Let's go back to Aesthia! Take me to Storm City, to the Skyport, and to the Fluffball we didn't defeat last time! Our adventure is not over yet, wake up, Grandpa!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...Grandpa?
(Transition)
The fireplace goes out. The girl sits alone in the pitch-dark room.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...The Dragon of Genesis is gone, but... the adventures in Aesthia are not over yet...
She catches the rulebook falling off the old man's hand and clutches it to her chest, sitting down before the sandbox. After that, time flies.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: The Isles of Aesthia form a new continent, floating high in the sky.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: The world created by the Dragon of Genesis will not disappear. It still has to... welcome even more adventurers.
The small sandbox begins stirring, a tiny yet magnificent port emerging in it. Next, Storm City, and the Fluffball...

Referring to her memories, she recreates the magnificent world she's heard about, in this small room, in this tiny square sandbox. Month after month, year after year, she pours all her energy into capturing every detail narrated by him.
(Transition)

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: The port, Storm City, the Fluffball... What else did he talk about...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Who... is he?
It's snowing in Aesthia.
The snow covers the whole world gradually, but Etti is not buried in it. An enormous wing shields her from the snowstorm, despite being wounded and scarred itself.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...Dragon of Genesis?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I'm sorry, I... still can't remember what you looked like.
She suddenly laughs.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But I did create Aesthia, and others come here for adventures now. Do you see that?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: He must have had a lot of fun, just like I once did.
steps.female_content: She must have had a lot of fun, just like I once did.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: That makes you happy too, right?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I had a lot of fun.
Fun? You gave me so much trouble.

steps.content: Hearing the unexpected voice, Etti only realizes now that someone else is standing outside the curtain.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...It's you? I thought you left? According to the rules...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Didn't you say that this is the freest game?

steps.content: (Scene change)

You haven't left this world. You're seeing Etti after she's inherited the Dragon of Genesis' power. This is the last legacy, the last Memory Fragment. You'll receive the real power that created this world.

Light spills out in all directions. The Dragon of Genesis' power peels away from the Dragon of Delusion, flowing into the sun in the sky. The girl floats in the air. This world's constraints on you have been lifted.
But somehow the shackles' mark has suddenly appeared on her. Following the mark, you come behind the curtain.
(Transition)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mania will not corrupt you further. I know where you are... We'll go look for you soon, the real you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...Alright, come and find me then.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Let's go on adventures together. Play a more interesting game with me. I'll create an even better world while I wait for you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Don't keep me waiting though... I'll feel... very lonely...
[Transition and fade out]
Lonely, huh?

<size=32>You recall the last scene you saw. The dragon beside her fades and turns into a swordswoman, a female bandit, a mechanic, and faces you have and haven't seen in the game. At last, it turns into an old man in modern clothing you've never met before.</size>
That ray of light born from the heart of the Dragon of Genesis has in fact always protected everyone in this world, including this cold, lonely little dragon.
Artificial sunlight filters through the window onto your desk, forming several luminous paths. In the outside world, spring is already here...
The adventure in Dragon & Isle of Sky has come to an end. There are no new players in Etti's world at the moment.
Apparently, in the third edition, the Ice Plague in Aesthia has become a harmless force.
On the thawed earth, Tetya eventually becomes a regular messenger.
Tierney goes to learn the violin and becomes a renowned bard in the entire Aesthia.
Things don't go as well for Erwin. He's been sent to a children's school, though he does way better than the other students.
Oh, about Cyrus. He seems to be in symbiosis with his creation and has turned into a "two-headed" dragon with only one head.
As for the other Cyrus, he still hasn't gotten over that failed game. "What kind of game is this? I'm sure I had the correct guide!"
In the Bureau, the Sinners haven't left the Recreation Room for days. "I'm the castellan! I'm the castellan! You all must listen to me!"
On a street in Eastside, a certain Sinner peeks at this peculiar board game shop through his glasses. "...Why does it feel so familiar?"
Etti in the shop is jolly. She's just spent several days developing a new racing board game. "DisChess' tenth extension pack shall be designed by me!"
This is the end of the observation record of this event. In the dark, a clear paper-tearing noise can be heard.
